description: Verifies a Kaneme certificate from its TOKEN (from a /certificat/… URL or a badge). Returns the PUBLIC attestation: issuer, type (text or voice), the authorship band or maturity level, subject, date, engine version and page URL. Never a fine-grained score: only what the public page shows. NO credits, no voice required, any token, including another account’s. Unknown, invalid or revoked token = `verified:false`: "not attested", NEVER an outage to retry. `textDigest` is SHA-256 over kaneme-text-v1. remove U+200B, U+2060 and U+FEFF (preserve U+200D); NFC; replace every ECMAScript whitespace run (/\s+/gu, including NBSP) with U+0020; trim; UTF-8 without BOM; SHA-256 in lowercase hexadecimal. `signedCore` is stored at issuance; localized claims labels are outside its Ed25519 signature. Legacy certificates stay origin with null digest/signature. Voice certificates attest no text.
name: verify_certificate
title: Verify a public certificate
